edits.old: the rule set again, here from what it has picked.
edits.new: the rule set again; between updates it stays as it was. What it is set from differs from step to step, and each step says: its own picks, or judgments.
edits.why: In the Lean an update is a step at which the rule is read anew (Pace.paced, reads t = true). It is read from the picks alone only under ReadsShare (steps 2, 3, 6); in steps 9 and 10 it reads the loss (Thinned.lossPool, Beyond.lossRead). Step 2 states 'updated from its own picks' as a condition and step 17 says no law gives it, so it cannot be part of the word.

edits.why: Small. The Lean has one quantity (the share, ordered by carriers against others); steps 2 and 7 call it the share, steps 3, 5, 10 and 16 the lead. The entry reads as two quantities.

edits.where: lock.cast[3] (the rest / 其余的), says_en, whole value
edits.old: what is picked among besides the favoured side.
edits.new: what is picked among besides the favoured side. Where the rule is set from the judgments of what it picked (steps 7, 9 and 14), the rest judge too, and weigh by their numbers.
edits.why: Both readings are true and the steps need the second. In the Lean the others are the other kind of what is picked (CarrierCounts.other); in every step that uses the phrase (7, 9, 14) the rule is the pool of readers drawn from what is picked, each kind counted by its numbers (ClosedCapture.Drawn.pool), so the rest are also among those that set the rule. Without that, 'the rest count the loss' does not say their counting reaches the rule.
